Then the other two cells in column 1 cannot be covered vertically (a vertical piece would need the whole column), so they are also horizontal, covering columns 1–3 entirely and leaving a 3×(n-3) board: a(n-3) ways. Hence a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-3), with a(0)=1, a(1)=1, a(2)=1. Iterating: a(3)=2, a(4)=3, a(5)=4, a(6)=6, a(7)=9, a(8)=13, a(9)=19, a(10)=28, a(11)=41, a(12)=60.
